ModMetaData.name: Kiiro Schizonepeta Gum
ModMetaData.author: Cancelation
ModMetaData.description: 新增药品：口香糖（荆芥口味）。食用后增加娱乐并缓慢回血。 绮罗族和猫受伤后会主动寻找并服用口香糖。 注：服用后，不知为何有一股神秘力量会把服用者硬控再原地，建议在医疗床附近存放该药物。 A chewing gum made from schizonepeta leaves. Chewing it lifts the mood and slowly regenerates wounds. The Kiiros and cats will automatically find and ingest the gum after they are injured. Note: After ingesting the gum, a mysterious force will hold the patient in place, and it is recommended to store the drug near a bed.
